caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object standing upright in the center of the composition, rendered in shades of gray and black on a cream-colored background. The object consists of a vertical shaft with a rounded top and a prominent, curved horizontal arm extending from its upper section, ending in a cylindrical cup-like feature. The lower portion of the object branches into three curved legs that spread outward, providing stability and balance. The lines and shading give the object a three-dimensional appearance, and it is centrally placed within a rectangular border. There are no additional objects or elements in the composition, and a signature is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Candle and Rush Light Holder
